Neha (PM): FYI starting intake for a timeboxed enterprise trial request from Acme Corp — 2 week trial, needs fast onboarding + acceptance criteria. Posting problem/goals/non-goals/metrics below.

Sam (Eng): Thanks — can you paste minimal reqs? We'll need expected QPS and model(s).

Neha (PM): Problem: Acme wants a 2-week trial with dedicated capacity and easy rollback; they need predictable p95 latency and a hard cost cap during trial. We need a short PRD to align eng, SRE, and legal.

Neha (PM): Goals:
- 2-week customer-seeded trial environment (isolated tenant)
- Dedicated instances with reserved burst capacity up to 2x baseline
- Onboard within 48h of signed MSA
- Acceptance criteria: p95 <= 300ms for generation endpoint; availability >= 99.5%; trial daily cost <= agreed cap

Neha (PM): Non-goals:
- This is not a production migration path (no multi-region HA for trial)
- No extended log retention or analytics beyond 2 weeks
- We will not provision on-prem during trial

Neha (PM): Success metrics:
- Onboarding time <= 48h from signed addendum
- p95 <= 300ms for at least 90% of trial days
- No more than 1 failover incident during trial window
- Customer trial satisfaction NPS >= 40 at end of trial

Marco (SRE): Quick Qs: DDoS/burst protection — do we give them a separate ACL? We should enforce per-tenant rate limits and an emergency throttle. Also need a runbook for failover and rollback.

Hana (Solutions): I'll own the run-of-show and the customer-facing playbook. Do we have billing cap enforcement? We need an automated stop or alert if they approach the cap.

Lance (ML): Which model families are in scope? Do we allow quantized variants or only verified builds? Need list of allowed model hashes. QC evals should run before enabling.

Sam (Eng): Engineering asks: expected peak concurrency, average sequence length, and whether streaming is required. Also what level of access to observability (logs/traces) do we grant? Canary + rollback plan will be required.

Neha (PM): Answers: peak concurrency ~50 rps, avg sequence length ~256 tokens, streaming optional (preferred), observability: token-level cost and p95 traces for the tenant but limited retention (2w). Models in scope: 12B open checkpoint (verified) and a 7B quantized variant we've tested in staging.

legal-bot: FYI — Legal requires a signed MSA + trial addendum before we enable dedicated tenancy. Do not proceed until CLA confirmed.

ops-bot: Automated note: onboarding checklist created at /onboard/1728605555. Task owners: Sam (infra estimate), Marco (runbook), Hana (customer playbook), Legal (MSA).

Neha (PM): Next steps: Sam to estimate infra delta & incremental cost, Marco to draft runbook, Hana to prepare playbook + demo script, Legal to confirm MSA. Can everyone review and confirm by EOD Thursday? :eyes: 

Sam (Eng): I'll have a high-level infra delta and cost estimate by EOD Thu.

Marco (SRE): I'll draft the runbook and rollback steps in the next 24h.

Hana (Solutions): I'll draft the customer playbook and demo script; will sync with Sam tomorrow to align on observability.

Neha (PM): Thanks all — scheduling a 30m sync for tomorrow. /remind @channel to review acceptance criteria tomorrow at 10:00am :calendar:
